title: I Don't Congregate Because Of You!!
body:
15 Minutes w/ The Captains · 2025-11-17

Opens [Heb 10](/bible/hebrews/10) · [Heb 3](/bible/hebrews/3) · [Heb 11](/bible/hebrews/11) · [Wis 7](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/7) · [Rev 3](/bible/revelation/3) · [Sir 4](/bible/sirach/4) · [2 Tim 2](/bible/2-timothy/2) · [Rom 8](/bible/romans/8) · [Tobit 4](/bible/tobit/4) · [Ps 122](/bible/psalms/122) · [Ps 42](/bible/psalms/42) · [Ps 35](/bible/psalms/35)
## Introduction *[[0:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=5s)]* Hey, shalom. Shalom Israel. Most High bless. Hey, all praise to the Most High God. Hey, welcome to another edition of 15 minutes with the captains. I'm Captain Joel, and today 15 minute topic is I don't congregate because of you. That's the topic. So what we got to do is stop using people as an excuse to forsake the Lord. A lot of times people come into the truth, come congregate, and then they stop coming and become what? Stay on their couch and start watching and say, You know what, I don't congregate because of this person. I don't congregate because of that person. All those things, that's an excuse to forsake the Lord. ## Scriptures Opened **[Hebrews 10:24-25](/bible/hebrews/10#v24)** *[[0:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=57s)]* > [24](/bible/hebrews/10#v24) And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works: > > [25](/bible/hebrews/10#v25) Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching. - And let us consider one another: Let us consider one another. When you at home, you cannot consider one another, because it's only you and your TV and the couch. - to provoke unto love and to good works: How can you provoke, or how can somebody else provoke you to good works, if you're not present? If you saying, You know what, I'm not going to congregate because of you, or because of that sister, or because of that brother. - Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together: Not forsaking the assembly of ourselves. - but exhorting one another: It say exhorting one another. - and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching: It says so much the more. Because what? We're living in the last days and we are seeing the day approaching. So therefore, we got to be together. We have to be together. **[Hebrews 10:38-39](/bible/hebrews/10#v38)** *[[1:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=118s)]* > [38](/bible/hebrews/10#v38) Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him. > > [39](/bible/hebrews/10#v39) But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul. - but if any man draw back: If any man draw back, meaning that what? You making an excuse now for you to forsake the Lord, for you to forsake the assembly of ourselves together. - my soul shall have no pleasure in him: No pleasure at all. - But we are not of them who draw back: We are not of them who draw back. Because once you start coming out, you making an excuse, say, Oh, I don't congregate because of you, because of you. Because of you, you are drawing back. And nine out of 10 that will lead you toward the world. - unto perdition: That's all you're drawing back to: destruction. - but of them that believe to the saving of the soul: You see that? That's what you got to do. That's what I got to do. Because by congregating, by being in the presence of believers, it strengthen you and it strengthen me. So we cannot make an excuse. Stop using people as an excuse to not come to the Sabbath, or to forsake the Lord, because that's what you're doing. That's exactly what you're doing. **[Hebrews 3:13](/bible/hebrews/3#v13)** *[[3:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=226s)]* > [13](/bible/hebrews/3#v13) But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin. - But exhort one another daily: Because a lot of times we literally will tell leadership, Oh, I don't congregate because of that person, or I don't congregate because of this person. That's a wrong spirit to be wrote in. Exhort one another daily, because one person cannot do it by themselves. It is impossible. When you see a sheep by itself, what the lion do? What a wolf do? What a hyena do? It devour that sheep. - lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin: See that? Lest any of you be hardened. Because what? When you by yourself, you will be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin. You're not with a congregation. You're not getting built up. You by yourself making that excuse to forsake the Lord: I don't congregate because of you. Now you going to what? Sin is going to deceive you, and you going to act upon it. **[Hebrews 11:25](/bible/hebrews/11#v25)** *[[4:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=279s)]* > [25](/bible/hebrews/11#v25) Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season; - Choosing rather to suffer affliction: What Moses did? So Moses chose rather to suffer affliction with his people. A lot of times, one thing happen, we don't want to be with our people anymore. We say, You know what, I'm watch from home. You know what? I like to be by myself. No, God didn't call you to say what you want to do, or be the same person that you were before. Nah. **[Wisdom of Solomon 7:27](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/7#v27)** *[[5:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=324s)]* > [27](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/7#v27) And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she maketh all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she maketh them friends of God, and prophets. - And being but one, she can do all things: Because you're going to tell people, Oh, that's how I am, that's who I am. So you going to be that old negro that you used to be, that old ways that you used to have? You going to stay, and you not change? See what the Bible say. - she maketh all things new: She maketh all things new. So you shouldn't be your old self. You shouldn't be your old self at all. You come to this truth, you got to what? Endeavor to keep the unity. You got to want to be with your people. You got to love your people. Don't say, Oh, that's how I am. I like to be by myself. I like to be alone. No, no, no, no, no, no. Zephaniah 2 said, Gather yourself together. Don't use people as an excuse to forsake the Lord. So, I don't congregate because of you? Nah. A lot of us do those things, different country, different city: we keep to ourself and lie and make an excuse to not congregate. - and in all ages entering into holy souls, she maketh them friends of God, and prophets **[Hebrews 11:25](/bible/hebrews/11#v25)** *[[6:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=397s)]* > [25](/bible/hebrews/11#v25) Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season; - Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God: So you and I got to choose the right side. You and I got to choose the right side. You want to be by yourself at home, or you want to be with the people of God? With the people of God: that's assembling. That's the assembling. Being with your people. - than to enjoy the pleasures of sin: See that? To enjoy the pleasure. Because that's what going to happen to you if you by yourself. That's exactly what's going to happen. - for a season: For a season. For a season. **[Revelation 3:11-12](/bible/revelation/3#v11)** *[[7:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=456s)]* > [11](/bible/revelation/3#v11) Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown. > > [12](/bible/revelation/3#v12) Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name. - Behold, I come quickly: I don't congregate because of you. Okay. Really? Okay. You going to have somebody take your crown. He say, I come quickly. - hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown: And no man take your crown. Don't say you don't keep God's laws because of somebody. No. This place is a hospital. Everybody learning. Everybody bettering themselves. So maybe somebody might step on your shoes, and then you say, You know what? I'm not going to congregate no more. Nah, you going to do that to your own detriment. You will do that to your own detriment, for real. Maybe she or he may not done it, or did it, so you can gain that person over. But don't sit home and make an excuse, say, I'm not going to congregate because of person A or person C. No, no, no. That's the wrong spirit. - Him that overcometh will I make a pillar: See that? He that overcome. Overcome your pride. Overcome the demon that's in you, because that's a demon that will allow you to say, You know what, I don't congregate because of that person. You're not overcoming pride. You're not being humble to fix that between you and that person, but you rather want to stay home. - and I will write upon him my new name: So are you going to miss all that, and skip that, because of somebody? Seriously? Come on, man. **[Sirach 4:22](/bible/sirach/4#v22)** *[[9:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=592s)]* > [22](/bible/sirach/4#v22) Accept no person against thy soul, and let not the reverence of any man cause thee to fall. - Accept no person against thy soul: Because all I see is just excuse. People just make excuse to not congregate, to entertain their flesh. Because they're dealing with some sin that they don't want it to be exposed. So therefore they stay home. See that? Accept no person against thy soul. - and let not the reverence of any man cause thee to fall: Don't allow nobody to come between you and your God. Don't let nobody come between you and your God. **[2 Timothy 2:20-21](/bible/2-timothy/2#v20)** *[[10:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=625s)]* > [20](/bible/2-timothy/2#v20) But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour. > > [21](/bible/2-timothy/2#v21) If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work. - But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth: See that? It said in a great house there's not only vessels of gold. - and some to honour: Some to honor. Why am I bringing that out? Because some people in the congregation is not right. They going to step on your shoes. That is normal. Don't allow it to make you stay home, or not come to the Sabbath. Not everybody yet, right? That is a norm, because this is a hospital. People come with different different issues. So do not allow somebody, or a hiccup, somebody's mistake, to allow you to sit home and say, I'm not going to congregate because of that person. No, that's the wrong spirit. - and some to dishonour: Some to dishonor. Because some are not right. They just want to be dramatic. But you cannot pull anybody over your salvation. No. No. No. - If a man therefore purge himself from these: Because even the good people within the congregation and the bad people in the congregation, all of them are there to try you and to prove you. That's what it's there for. The bad people in the congregation is to try your patience, try your longsuffering, all those things. But because you don't want to endeavor, you don't want to endure, you say, You know what, I'm going to be at home. I'm going to be at home. But the Lord say you should gather yourself on the Sabbath day. That's a commandment that you are breaking. - he shall be a vessel unto honour: See that? That person that step on your shoes, once they change, they will be a vessel to honor. So why are you allowing them to allow you to stay home, to be a stumbling block? No, don't do that. - and prepared unto every good work: That's it. People here are working on themselves. So don't allow someone's action to stop you from serving the Lord. **[Romans 8:35-39](/bible/romans/8#v35)** *[[13:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=790s)]* > [35](/bible/romans/8#v35) Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword? > > [36](/bible/romans/8#v36) As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter. > > [37](/bible/romans/8#v37) Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us. > > [38](/bible/romans/8#v38) For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, > > [39](/bible/romans/8#v39) Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord. - Who shall separate us from the love of Christ?: That's a question right there, because you staying at home now. Who? That's the question. You don't congregate? The Bible say, Who's going to separate us? Nobody. No affliction. Not nobody should do that, to come between us and our God. - Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors: See that? In all these things we are more than conquerors. - nor things present: Things present. - nor any other creature: Any other creature. That's including your neighbor, including the people that will be in the sanctuary. Any other creature. - shall be able to separate us from the love of God: So why you allowing somebody to separate you then? Why you staying at home, say you don't congregate because of somebody? That mean you got a devil on you, and you got to repent and get your mind right. - which is in Christ Jesus: Nobody should come between you and your God. Nobody. **[Tobit 4:13](/bible/tobit/4#v13)** *[[14:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RUOD_FCywwU&t=898s)]* > [13](/bible/tobit/4#v13) Now therefore, my son, love thy brethren, and despise not in thy heart thy brethren, the sons and daughters of thy people, in not taking a wife of them: for in pride is destruction and much trouble, and in lewdness is decay and great want: for lewdness is the mother of famine. - Now therefore, my son, love thy brethren: Love your brethren. A lot of times we have hatred for our own people. It allow us to not come, to not want to be around them. - and despise not in thy heart thy brethren: See that? Don't despise your brother or your sister in your heart for you to make a remark saying, I don't congregate because of you. People will never be making exactly the same remark, same sentence: I don't congregate because of you. Can't make this up. You to serve the person that make you not congregate, or you to serve the Lord? Last time I checked, we all here to serve the Lord, and we all to use the Bible to fix issues that we have with one another. So are you going to allow emotion to come in the way and allow you not to serve the Lord? Come on, man. Come on now. Sheesh. That's all I want on that.
